Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro at Demo Day last week — Leapboard enjoyed the session. We are evaluating Redwood for a cross-team pilot (3 product teams, two month PoC per team) and wanted to check whether our existing sandbox stipend (from an incubator partner) can be combined with any promotional/top-up credits for a short-term burst.

Specific asks:
- Can promo credits be applied across multiple sub-accounts/projects under a single Leapboard org?
- Is there an option to convert unused sandbox stipend into a billed credit or a one-off promotional top-up?
- Any special pricing or conversion path if we commit to a Dedicated pool within 90 days?

Attached is a rough usage forecast for the pilot (Leapboard-usage-forecast.xlsx). Our procurement team (procure@leapboard.ai) will handle contracts if we move forward.

Would love a quick run-through of options — happy to hop on a 30m call.

Hi Sam — great to hear from you and thanks for the forecast. Short answers up front: yes (with constraints), and yes — there is a convert/rollover path but it depends on the incubator terms.

High-level options:
- Sandbox + Promo Synthesis: We can apply a one-time promo top-up across multiple sub-accounts if Leapboard accepts a conversion addendum; promo credits are allocated at the org level and we can map to projects at setup time.
- Dedicated Conversion Incentive: If you sign a 3-month committed Dedicated slot within 90 days, we can offer a 40% off unit-rate for up to the committed capacity for the first 60 days and an additional 5k free token-equivalent promo for onboarding.
- Billing path: We typically do a single invoice per org; Laura (cc'd) handles finance routing and will confirm invoice split options and any tax implications.

Next step: can you send a short list of the projects (names + expected peak QPS) and the incubator T&Cs for the stipend? I can get a draft addendum and a pricing sheet over to you. If this fits, we'll loop Priyom for onboarding cadence.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

Sam — short answers and an action plan below. See attached pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx and a draft SOW (SOW-draft.pdf) for the conversion path.

1) Promo size: The 5k figure is token-equivalent (we convert promo credit to a dollar amount at time of issuance based on the model profile you choose). Roughly that maps to approximately $5k of usage at our current hosted rates for the curated small-sequence image/text model families; the final $ amount will be shown on the pricing sheet and set in the addendum.

2) Deployment applicability: Promo credits can be redeemed on Redwood-hosted and Dedicated pools. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we require a separate purchase order and follow different invoicing — credits won't auto-apply to customer-managed private infra unless specifically written into the contract.

Action items:
- Vanessa: prepare conversion addendum for incubator stipend (you should send incubator T&Cs).
- Laura: confirm invoice-splitting and whether Leapboard can receive a segmented invoice (org-level + project-level breakout).
- Priyom: prep an onboarding playbook assuming 3 teams; we can compress the schedule if you take the Dedicated incentive.

If Leapboard is comfortable with the incentive and billing path, I can send the addendum + DocuSign link by EOD Monday.

Thanks — attaching quoted thread.

— Vanessa
